analyze_model_flops_total: create a FlopCountAnalysis to compute the total flop count for a PyTorch model given sample inputs
analyze_flops_by_operator: use FlopCountAnalysis by_operator method to get a Counter of flop counts grouped by operator type
analyze_flops_by_module: use FlopCountAnalysis by_module method to get flop counts for each submodule in a PyTorch model
analyze_flops_by_module_and_operator: use FlopCountAnalysis by_module_and_operator to get a nested dictionary of flop counts by module and operator
compute_gflops_with_flop_count: call flop_count function to compute per-operator GFLOPs and get unsupported operations for a model
